programmes.d: When Festus and a wounded robber are put up at a farmhouse the owner attempts to kill the robber and seize the stolen money.
An ex-slave is bribed by two desperados to steal an important document from a wounded Matt Dillon.
When Matt arrests a young stagecoach robber, his notorious older brother and his gang pursue the marshal, seeking his death.
An old-time con-man, dying of a heart condition, manages to help save Matt's life.
An outlaw's return to his homestead to claim some hidden loot leads to nothing but trouble.
Louie Pheeters is found intoxicated beside a dying man and, unable to remember what took place, is accused of murder.
A young schoolmarm's unscrupulous relatives descend on Dodge City to begin a moonshining operation.
When Festus helps a woman school teacher get to Cimarron territory, they both become hostages of a family of hide thieves.
People suspect ex-gunfighter Jake MacGraw has ulterior motives when he gets a job as a piano player in the Long Branch Saloon.
The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter.
A contemptible father pretends to have a change of heart when three nuns confront him about the care and custody of his two children.
When a young outlaw becomes the victim of his own gang, he decides to help Marshal Matt Dillon bring them in.
Kitty, en route from Owl Flats to Dodge City by buckboard, is kidnapped by Apache war priest Gregorio, an escaped cavalry prisoner.
A wily little thieving orphan first steals from Marshal Dillon, then sets out to help him in an impending ambush.
The feud between ranchers Noah Haimes and Clete Bolden is rekindled by the romance of Haimes's only son and Bolden's only daughter.
When an old friend of Doc Adams is suspected of being a thief, Doc takes it upon himself to bring the man to justice.
Kitty Russell, seeing Matt wounded again, closes the Long Branch and leaves Dodge City to become a partner with an old friend.
Three teenage boys, on probation from the county jail, are welcomed in Dodge City for a while.
A young drifter kidnaps Kitty and holds her captive in a ghost town to lure Doc Adams, Festus, and Matt to the area.
Doc Adams considers it a threat to both him and his patients when a woman doctor arrives to become his replacement.
A heavy-handed land baron refuses to turn his two sons over to Marshal Dillon for a crime they have committed.
United States Marshal Matt Dillon of Dodge City must deal with fast trigger-happy outlaw Dan Grat (Paul Richards) who wants his way with the town.
Matt must defend a gunman he despises from townspeople who want to lynch him for a crime he didn't commit.
To save his own life, murder witness Doc gives his word of honor to the killers (including Claude Akins) that he won't expose them.
Matt tries to save the life of a man dying of gangrene.
